hook.subline: Bhejne se pehle ye padh lo.

items.title: Subject line clear rakho
items.detail: Naam, course aur intake, subject mein hi likh do. Padhne wale ko turant samajh aaye.

items.title: Pehle website check karo
items.detail: Jo jawab website ya FAQ pe already hai, wo email mein mat poochho.

items.title: Chhota aur seedha likho
items.detail: Ek email mein ek kaam. Do teen chhote paragraph kaafi hain.

items.title: Simple email ID se bhejo
items.detail: Apne naam wali email ID rakho. Nicknames wali ID serious nahi lagti.

youtube.title: University ko email kaise likhein? 4 seedhi tips
youtube.description:
Admissions team ko email bhejne se pehle: subject line clear rakho, pehle website aur FAQ check karo, chhota aur seedha likho, aur apne naam wali email ID se bhejo.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
